description: Renders every frame of a film to an H.264 MP4 at low priority, with the in-page hardware encoder by default. Before saving, it checks the file: every rendered frame decodes and the soundtrack runs from the start to the end of the film; a short or misaligned file fails. Returns the output path, frame count, time and encoder (enc=wc is the fast path), not the progress log. Sends progress if the client asks for it.

allow_short_audio.description: Set true only when the soundtrack is meant to end before the film: it is then left short instead of padded. Default false.

audio.description: Sound file to mux in (AAC 192k). A soundtrack shorter than the film is padded with silence; a longer one is cut at the end. For a mastered mix use mux_audio instead.

demo.description: Folder that holds the film's index.html (absolute path, or relative to the library root).

encoder.description: auto (default) tries WebCodecs, then VideoToolbox, then x264.

mbps.description: Bitrate for the WebCodecs path. Default 20.

out.description: Output mp4. Default <demo>/out/video.mp4. Each parallel render needs its own out.

q.description: Query string passed to the page as location.search, e.g. 'lang=en&cut=b'.

size.description: Frame size WxH, even numbers. Default 1920x1080; 1080x1920 for a vertical Short.

name: render_video
title: Render the film to MP4
